name: Rejuvenation
overview: Rejuvenation in Scripture is closely tied to the blessings and renewal that come from trusting in the LORD and living a generous, grace-filled life. The Psalmist calls believers to bless the LORD with all their soul, reflecting an inward renewal of spirit, while Proverbs teaches that a liberal soul is refreshed and rewarded. Jeremiah emphasizes the blessedness of placing hope in God, and Colossians encourages speech seasoned with grace, signaling a renewed character in Christ. Together, these verses reveal that true rejuvenation springs from a heart anchored in God’s grace and active faith.
